summary: A dual-tower cable crossover station (3.6 m wide, 2.4 m tall): two weight-stack towers, each with 18 selector… joints stack_l, pulley_l, stack_r, pulley_r; options frame, accent, shroud; sockets socket_handle_l, socket_handle_r, stand_user.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.cable_crossover or place "prefab": "cable_crossover" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
